title: PostgreSQL platform bootstrap, roles and tenant isolation

acceptance_gates.description: PostgreSQL 18 baseline with pgvector is provisioned and asserted by an integration test.
Distinct application, migration and maintenance roles exist; the application role is NOBYPASSRLS.
Transaction-scoped SET LOCAL app.workspace_id drives RLS, fails closed when unset, and does not leak past COMMIT.
Adversarial cross-workspace access testing records zero leaks across at least 10,000 attempts.
